title: Custom Crossbow Sounds
description:
🏹 Custom Crossbow Sounds
🎯 Get audio & visual notifications the moment your crossbow bolt lands on an enemy — never miss a hit again!
🔊 Custom hit sounds
🖼️ Arrow display on screen
⚡ Two different charge indicator styles
⚙️ Version: 1.21.11 | Fabric |
body:
# 🏹 __**Custom Crossbow Sounds**__

✨ Crossbow Sounds enhances your crossbow experience in Minecraft with both **audio and visual notifications** when you hit an enemy with a crossbow bolt!

─────────────────────

🔔 __**Hit Notifications**__

Get instant audio and visual feedback every time your crossbow bolt lands on an enemy. Choose between **custom sounds** or the built-in default sounds, and freely adjust the volume to your liking.

─────────────────────

🏹 __**Arrow Display**__

See exactly which arrow is loaded inside your crossbow directly from your inventory. If your crossbow contains a different type of arrow, it will be displayed alongside it as well.

─────────────────────

🎯 __**Crossbow Charge Indicator**__

Two styles to choose from while charging your crossbow:

🍕 **Style 1** — A pizza-slice shaped indicator below your crosshair
⭕ **Style 2** — A donut-shaped ring around your crosshair

Press **O** to toggle between indicator positions!

─────────────────────

⚙️ __**Mod Menu Support**__

Customize everything directly from the Mod Menu settings:
✅ Toggle each feature on or off
✅ Resize indicators
✅ Adjust transparency

─────────────────────
